# Massive Integrated Homes (MIH)

> Licensed electrical contractor and smart home integrator based in Greenslopes and Salisbury, Brisbane. We install home automation, lighting, home theatre, TV feature walls, CCTV, EV chargers, Starlink and mesh WiFi across central and south Brisbane, Logan and the Gold Coast, and also work in north Brisbane. Electrical Contractor Licence No. 1508151. Phone 0480 568 180 (Nate) or 0490 792 415 (Mitch). Mon-Sat 7am-7pm.
